newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Huandao gains approval to offer A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Huandao gains approval to offer A shares.

text.p: Hotelier Hainan Huandao Industrial Co Ltd has won approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission to launch an offer of 31 million A shares in the near future, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The offer, which has been priced at 6.15 yuan per share, would be made via the Shenzhen bourse's automated quotation system by the end of this month, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.
Shenzhen Guotou Securities Co Ltd has been appointed to underwrite the listing in Shenzhen, the official said.

Huandao, which owns a five-star hotel and some entertainment facilities in Haikou, capital of Hainan province, aims to channel the share proceeds into its main operations and the construction of a hydropower plant in Sichuan, he said.

Huandao forecast net profits of 50 million yuan for 1997 against 38.53 million yuan in 1996 and 24 million yuan in 1995, he said. The firm currently has 89.60 million outstanding shares, composed of 64 million legal person shares and 25.60 million staff shares.

Earlier this month, company officials said China Huandao Group Co, a conglomerate that has about a 53 percent equity stake in the hotelier, planned to apply for an offer of H shares -- stock issued by mainland Chinese firms for listing in Hong Kong --- by the end of this year.

China Huandao, which is owned by the Ministry of Public Security, is among the 38 domestic enterprises recently selected by the Securities Commission of the State Countil as candidates for overseas listing.
The scale of China Huandao's H share offer was not yet fixed, the official said and gave no further details.
